title: ESIIPayment Provider Metadata
description: Catalog and provenance information for one provider, stored at providers/<provider>/metadata.yaml. Drives the generated provider catalog and capability matrix (docs.yml) and the adapter-tier and verification-status displays. Separate from manifest.yaml, which is purely technical.

provider.description: Must match the provider slug in the sibling manifest.yaml and the directory name.

tier.description: Adapter tier. community: validates, cassettes present, golden output matches. certified: adds a live sandbox run and a named maintainer. official: core-team maintained, provider acknowledged. See GOVERNANCE.md.

description.description: One or two sentences describing this provider for the generated catalog.

status.description: provisional: endpoint paths, field names, and webhook signature scheme are unverified against current provider documentation. verified: a maintainer has confirmed this manifest against current, licensed-to-read provider documentation. Must be displayed prominently in the generated catalog.

docs_verified_on.description: ISO-8601 date this manifest was last checked against provider documentation. Must be null while status is provisional; must be a date once status is verified.

verified_by.description: GitHub handle of the maintainer who performed the verification. Must be null while status is provisional; must be set once status is verified.

notes.description: Free-text caveats. While provisional, must explain which fields are unverified and why. Never present a guess as a confirmed fact here.

maintainers.description: Named maintainers for this provider. Required to have at least one entry when tier is certified or official.

links.description: Public links shown in the generated catalog.
